messages:
sam: Hey devex — pushed a hybrid Next.js boilerplate that wires LangChain + LlamaIndex + Redwood SDK. Getting weird auth/retry behavior during SSR (server-side render). Anyone seen this?

anya: link? curious to try the repo.

sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-hybrid-boilerplate — steps: clone, cp .env.example .env, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, npm run dev. On first SSR request I see a 401 from the SDK's ephemeral token exchange; client-side fetches succeed after hydration.

matt: can you paste the server log snippet?

sam: sure — server log shows:
```
ERROR: /api/_ssr_call 401 Unauthorized — Redwood SDK token-exchange failed: missing session cookie
  at /app/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.js:45:12
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
```
No cookies present because SSR lambda runs without the browser session.

rohit: sounds like an SDK parity / runtime config issue. JS SDK tries a cookie-first flow on server and falls back poorly in edge SSR. We had a similar thing in eng-runtime with the "serverKey" vs ephemeral exchange. Quick workaround: set REDWOOD_API_MODE=server (uses service key from env) or provide REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY in .env.

liz: also noticed a retry loop for 429 when batching is enabled during prefetch. SSR ends up emitting repeated retries w/o backoff. Try setting batching.enabled=false for SSR route in the sample config.

anya: we should add a short e2e smoke to CI that hits the SSR route (puppeteer / playwright headless) so we catch auth/429 regressions. Also update the README .env example to call out REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY for local SSR dev.

sam: thanks — opening a PR with the doc update + a temporary fix to default to server mode for dev branches: github.com/redwood-inference/next-hybrid-boilerplate/pull/27 (WIP) :sparkles:

ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline failed on branch next-hybrid — eval-harness tests failed (1/12).

sam: ok I'll add the e2e test and a unit for the SDK server fallback, pushing a follow-up to the PR. will ping when green. :thumbsup:
